text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whew… The skincare section's radiating with feminine energy…

text_block_list.name: Cosmetics Shop Employee
text_block_list.text: How are you today? Are you interested in this glitter gel to make your skin sparkle? It's our number one best seller!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see… That's great. Um… Anyway…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …That was scary. I can't believe I ran off like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should just get it online… Wait, then I can't test it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Siiigh… Maybe I should just avoid being sparkly all together…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With glittery obstacles in her way, Nice Nature's journey to healthy skin continues.
